name: pull
description:
Download a model once into the cache, at its pinned revision, and check the checksum of each file.

A model already in the cache is not downloaded again.
A pull that fails keeps nothing of the model and exits 5; run it again.
A hub model (hf:<id>) is fetched at its latest revision: an ONNX export with tokenizer.json, or a model2vec model.

Example: semkit models pull e5-small

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The model: the encoder e5-small, bge-m3, potion, or hf:<id> of a model of the Hugging Face hub; the word data ruwordnet or navec.
